snippet.title: Buggos: Death Squad - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Buggos: Death Squad on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4093200/Buggos_Death_Squad/

Buggos: Death Squad is a 4-player co-op horde survival shooter with base building. Customize your loadout on the drop ship, land on a world the Buggos are eating alive, and raise a fortress of turrets. Hold it as the swarm attacks hundreds at a time and evolves every wave.

The Hivemind adapts to counter your build. New species, growing evolutions, and boss Buggos will assault your base as you try to hold out long enough to gather your research and escape.

Every building, weapon, and piece of armor has module sockets. Give your guns split shot or chain lightning, build a wall that shoots back at whatever hits it and explodes when it dies, and mix and match however you like.

They devour worlds. We defend them.

Coming January 2027. Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4093200/Buggos_Death_Squad/
